**1. The robot is e-stopped**
- Robot/sim-robot-002 status.estopState=Stopped
- Otherwise it looks able to work: Robot/sim-robot-002 status.phase=Idle, status.health.status=Healthy, status.batteryPercent=85, and both capabilities are Active (navigation, camera_front).
- Robot/sim-robot-002 has no Kubernetes Events, so they don't show when or why the stop was set.

**2. Its zone is e-stopped**
- Robot/sim-robot-002 spec.zone=warehouse-a
- FleetZone/warehouse-a status.estopStatus=Triggered, status.lastEstopAt=2026-11-03T14:05:00Z
- FleetZone/warehouse-a estopTriggeredAnnotation="estop drill". The stop was set as a drill and hasn't been cleared since.
- FleetZone/warehouse-a status.robotCount=3, so the stop affects other robots too. For example, FleetAction/deliver-pallet-001 (status.assignedRobot=sim-robot-001) has status.phase=Paused and status.message="interrupted by estop; awaits an operator decision".

**Other things that may matter after the stops are cleared**
- **The adapter shows no connected robots.** Robot/sim-robot-002 spec.adapter.name=sim-fleet-adapter. That adapter is up (FleetAdapter/sim-fleet-adapter status.phase=Connected, status.conformance=Passed), but its status.connectedRobots=0.
- **Waiting work can't find a robot.** FleetAction/inspect-receiving-dock (status.phase=Pending) needs exactly what sim-robot-002 has. Its status.message says: "no candidate robot: the robots without an adapter report no position, so none is placed in the zone". So the scheduler may not know where sim-robot-002 is, even with the stops cleared. Put together with the adapter showing no connected robots, this suggests the robot isn't actually talking to the adapter.
- **The zone's robot limit is 0.** FleetZone/warehouse-a spec.maxConcurrentRobots=0. I can't tell from what the tools return whether 0 means "no limit" or "no robots allowed", so this is worth checking.

**What happens next**
I can't clear an emergency stop, release a robot, or resume paused work. Clearing a stop is a safety decision, and it's left to people who can confirm the area is safe. The usual order is:
1. A floor or safety supervisor clears the zone stop on FleetZone/warehouse-a, which was set as a drill.
2. They clear the robot's own stop. Policy requires both to be clear before it can work again.
3. Whoever runs the robot connection checks why sim-fleet-adapter shows 0 connected robots.
4. An operator decides what to do with the paused deliver-pallet-001.

The most likely reason is that sim-robot-001's front camera is degraded, and this action requires the front camera. I can't confirm that it was ever assigned to sim-robot-001, though, because neither object has any events recorded.

**What the action needs and where it stands now**
- FleetAction/inspect-receiving-dock spec.requiredCapabilities=["navigation","camera_front"]
- FleetAction/inspect-receiving-dock status.assignedRobot=sim-robot-002
- FleetAction/inspect-receiving-dock status.phase=Succeeded, status.message="arrived at target"

**Why sim-robot-001 doesn't qualify right now**
- Robot/sim-robot-001 status.capabilities camera_front status=Degraded, reason="required hardware degraded"
- Robot/sim-robot-001 status.hardware camera_front status=Degraded
- Robot/sim-robot-001 status.health.status=Critical, status.health.message="non-pauseable capability not Active: camera_front"
- Its other capability is fine: Robot/sim-robot-001 status.capabilities navigation status=Active

A robot has to have every required capability Active to be picked. With camera_front Degraded, sim-robot-001 can't take this action.

**Why sim-robot-002 got it**
- Robot/sim-robot-002 status.capabilities camera_front status=Active, navigation status=Active
- Robot/sim-robot-002 status.hardware camera_front status=Healthy
- Robot/sim-robot-002 status.health.status=Healthy

**What I couldn't confirm**
- get_events returned no items for FleetAction/inspect-receiving-dock or Robot/sim-robot-001. That means I can't show whether sim-robot-001 was ever assigned or requested, or when its camera degraded compared with when the action was scheduled.
- Both robots have their ZonePositionOverdue condition with reason=PositionReported and status=False. That means neither robot's position is overdue, so it doesn't explain the switch.

**Next steps**
